title: SDF vs. MSDF vs. Slug: GPU Text Rendering
summary: This article compares three GPU-based text rendering techniques: SDF (Signed Distance Fields), MSDF (Multi-channel Signed Distance Fields), and Slug (commercial rendering library), analyzing their trade-offs in quality, performance, and implementation complexity.
problem_solved: Rendering crisp, scalable text on the GPU without the performance overhead of traditional texture-based font rendering.
why_valuable: Provides practical guidance for developers choosing between text rendering approaches, helping balance visual quality against implementation complexity and runtime performance.
